description: Keeps returning to the same two Italian recipes across sessions, barely glancing at anything else.
algorithm_design: Weighted revisit loop: 80%+ of impressions are the italian recipes at "love" level, repeated across 3 sessions; everything else gets a fast "skip"/"glance".

description: Browses widely across East and Southeast Asian cuisines, engaging positively with most of them.
algorithm_design: Uniform-ish sampling across an 8-cuisine regional cluster at "like"/"interested" level; occasional out-of-cluster "glance".

description: Selects almost exclusively by dietary tag (vegan/vegetarian) rather than cuisine, and always finishes checking every ingredient.
algorithm_design: Filters the whole catalogue by dietary_tags containing vegan/vegetarian first, then engages at "complete_prep" level regardless of cuisine.

description: Chases the "spicy" tag across every cuisine, ignoring mild dishes almost entirely.
algorithm_design: Filters catalogue by tags containing "spicy"; those get "love"/"like", everything mild gets a fast "skip".

description: Only ever engages with "easy" recipes — a busy weeknight cook who saves things to try later.
algorithm_design: Filters catalogue to difficulty_tier == easy; high save rate, moderate like rate, full prep-checking.

description: Gravitates to advanced, technique-heavy recipes and engages deeply with every one.
algorithm_design: Filters to difficulty_tier == advanced; consistently high dwell, full expand, full ingredient prep.

description: Never lands on a favourite — spreads attention near-uniformly across the entire cuisine catalogue and rarely repeats.
algorithm_design: Draws one fresh recipe from every distinct cuisine_id each session (max-entropy sampling), all at "interested" level, low save rate.

description: A super-engaged daily user who likes and saves almost everything she opens, across nearly the whole catalogue.
algorithm_design: Samples large batches (10-15) each session at "love"/"like" with high like+save probability — stress-tests the ranker with a dense, high-magnitude affinity vector.

description: Scrolls fast and rarely stops — almost every card is skipped with sub-2-second dwell.
algorithm_design: Samples broadly across the catalogue but assigns "skip"/"glance" to nearly everything, so almost no positive signal reaches the affinity model.

description: Just installed the app — no telemetry at all yet. Exercises the cold-start uniform-distribution path.
algorithm_design: Empty event array by design — generateUserAffinityVector() must fall back to a uniform distribution over all cuisines.

description: Opened the app a few times, disliked nearly everything shown, and stopped coming back.
algorithm_design: Every impression is a fast "dislike_skip" (sub-second dwell, no expand/like/save) — tests that floored-at-zero scores never go negative.

description: A meal-prep saver drawn to the Mediterranean / Middle Eastern comfort-food cluster.
algorithm_design: Filters to a 5-cuisine Mediterranean/Levant/Maghreb cluster; high save rate reflecting meal-prep batching behaviour.

description: Sticks to Latin American cuisines — Mexican, Peruvian, Brazilian, Argentinian, Caribbean.
algorithm_design: Filters to a 5-cuisine Latin American / Caribbean cluster at "like"/"love"; small amount of unrelated "glance" noise.

description: Purely random engagement across the whole catalogue — an adversarial baseline for testing ranking robustness.
algorithm_design: Every field (dwell, expand, like, save, checked count) is drawn from a uniform random distribution, independent of cuisine, tag, or difficulty.

description: Browses almost exclusively in the morning and gravitates to breakfast/brunch-tagged recipes.
algorithm_design: Filters catalogue by tags containing breakfast/brunch; all sessions start at 07:00-08:00.

description: One massive North Indian binge session months ago, then never opened the app again.
algorithm_design: A single very long, high-intensity session concentrated on one cuisine, dated far in the past, with no follow-up sessions at all.

description: Taste visibly drifts over time: North Indian a few months back, Korean recently, French most recently.
algorithm_design: Each session targets a different cuisine cluster in sequence (oldest to newest), simulating an evolving palate over multiple months.

description: Saves recipes compulsively for "someday" but almost never expands or likes anything.
algorithm_design: Every impression is "save_only": high save probability, low dwell, essentially no expand/like/ingredient signal.

description: A serious home cook who methodically checks off every single ingredient on every recipe he opens, focused on Indian home-cooking.
algorithm_design: Filters to Indian-subcontinent cuisines; every impression is "complete_prep" (100% ingredients checked, long dwell).

description: Loves broad home-style cooking but consistently skips German recipes the instant they appear.
algorithm_design: German-cuisine impressions are always forced "dislike_skip" while a rotating set of other cuisines gets "like"/"love" — isolates the skip-penalty term for one category.
